items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: We were on a ship, Carl Fontana and him and Pete, his brother Pete, and Bob Cooper was alive then, Bob was playing, myself, Randy Sandke, Ross Tompkins.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Man he’s really got a good ear too. But do you believe Conte Candoli in there tonight? I never heard music like that for years, except out of him. Boy was he playing, ooh, man. Some player that guy. Some player. We were on a ship, Carl Fontana and him and Pete, his brother Pete, and Bob Cooper was alive then, Bob was playing, myself, Randy Sandke, Ross Tompkins. Yeah, they worked us a little too much on this boat you know. We were supposed to go once then back. But we were playing three times a day, and…
